input: {"command":"$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $r = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://github.com/aWhiteWizard/small_UPS' -TimeoutSec 30; $c = $r.Content; foreach ($p in @('This repository is empty','Quick setup','repository is empty','<title>(.*?)</title>','\"defaultBranch\":(.*?),','empty')) { $m = [regex]::Matches($c, $p, 'IgnoreCase'); if ($m.Count -gt 0) { \"PATTERN [$p] hits=$($m.Count) first=$($m[0].Value.Substring(0,[Math]::Min(160,$m[0].Value.Length)))\" } else { \"PATTERN [$p] hits=0\" } }","description":"Check whether remote repo is empty","timeoutMs":60000}

PATTERN [This repository is empty] hits=1 first=This repository is empty
